channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Thanthi Group (dtnext.in)

item.title: 4 killed, 27 injured in bus-truck collision on Jaipur-Bikaner National Highway
item.description: The sleeper bus was travelling from Bikaner towards Jaipur when they rammed into each other.

item.title: Squash World Cup: India eases past Swiss in opener
item.description: India’s women’s No 1 Anahat Singh then doubled the advantage with a clinical display against Celine Walser. Anahat's soft hands and sharp drops kept Walser under pressure from the outset as she eased to a 7–1, 7–4, 7–2 win

item.title: International human rights lawyers warn of democratic backsliding in Bangladesh after verdicts against Hasina, family
item.description: Bangladesh’s International Crimes Tribunal (ICT) on November 17 pronounced a death sentence for Hasina after it found her guilty on the charges of crimes against humanity related to the demonstrations in July of last year

item.title: Jitesh shrugs off Samson 'rivalry', says healthy competition brings out his A-game
item.description: India once again preferred Jitesh over Sanju for the opening T20I of the five-match series against South Africa, a game the hosts won convincingly by 101 runs at Barabati Stadium on Tuesday

item.title: Amazon's biz plans: 35 bn, 80 bn exports, 3.8 mn jobs by 2030
item.description: In an interaction at the Smbhav Summit here, he said the company has set a target to quadruple exports from India to $80 billion from about $20 billion it has facilitated as of now and create an additional one million direct, indirect, induced and seasonal jobs by 2030.

item.title: Evacuation ordered as structures destroyed by bushfire in Australian state
item.description: Earlier, authorities announced that more than 30 homes had been damaged or destroyed by a bushfire in Tasmania

item.title: Failed to answer India's questions: Prince pulls up SA batters after record T20I collapse
item.description: Chasing 176, South Africa folded in 12.3 overs in a 101-run defeat in the opening match of the five-match series that marked the beginning of the two sides' build-up towards the global showpiece in India and Sri Lanka from February 7

item.title: AIADMK's key meetings today to finalise 2026 Assembly election strategy, pass political resolutions
item.description: The twin meetings are being seen as a decisive moment for the party as it attempts to regroup and chart its electoral course amid mounting political challenges.

item.title: Bomb threat triggers evacuation at east Delhi school; search underway
item.description: The threat call was received around 10.40 am, claiming that an explosive device had been planted inside Lovely Public School. The information was immediately relayed to the local police, fire department and other emergency agencies.

item.title: New Zealand loses Blair Tickner to injury but bowls out the West Indies for 205 in the 2nd test
item.description: Tickner fell heavily while fielding a ball at fine leg in his first test in more than two years and only the fourth of his career
